title: Backend 30 (Gov-scheme build)
subtitle: Learn 30 backend topics by building
intro: You learn the 30 backend topics by building the Gov-scheme recommender. Gate per phase: tests green + docker compose up green + one demoable endpoint.

tasks.html: HTTP + Routing: FastAPI app, routers/services split (routers/schemes.py, services/). Health route answers 200 with method + path logged.
CRUD deep-dive: schemes table (SQLite first, Postgres in Phase 2) — create/read/update/delete + pagination (limit/offset) + correct 200/201/400/404.
Serialisation: Pydantic v2 request/response models, strict types, one 422 sample captured in a test.
Validation + transformation: field validators normalize scheme payloads (trim, lowercase enums, date parse) — invalid input returns the error envelope, never 500.
Error handling: global handler → {error:{code,message,request_id}} for every failure path, tested.
Middlewares: request-ID + logging + CORS-locked-to-localhost, in that order. Explain why order matters.
Request context: request-scoped state via contextvar (request_id, user) — no globals leaking between requests.
Auth: login route issuing signed HttpOnly cookie (or JWT bearer); every mutating route gated; one 401 test + one 403 test.
REST + OpenAPI: resource naming pass, /docs renders with summaries + examples for all routes.
Config mgmt (seed): .env.example with every var documented; app refuses to boot with a clear message when required config is missing.

phases.name: Phase 2
phases.badge: Data + speed — DB, BLL, cache, search

tasks.html: Databases: SQLite → Postgres in compose; one real migration; one B-Tree index justified in one sentence.
DB depth: EXPLAIN ANALYZE before/after the index on your slowest query — paste both outputs in the README.
Business logic layer: eligibility engine returning eligible / needs_info / failed — rules are source of truth, LLM never overrides. Missing-age test included.
Caching: Redis cache-aside on scheme lookups with TTL + explicit invalidation on update. Hit/miss visible in logs.
Rate limiting: IP-based limit on eligibility endpoint; 429 body matches the error envelope.
Elasticsearch: hybrid keyword + vector search over schemes (Meilisearch acceptable if ES is heavy) — 5 seeded queries return the right scheme top-1.
Testing + quality: suite at 15+ tests (CRUD, BLL states, cache, search, auth) + ruff clean in CI.
Phase gate: pytest green + compose green + eligibility endpoint demoed to one human.
Task queuing + scheduling: Redis-backed queue (arq/dramatiq, no Kafka) — ingestion job enqueues, worker consumes, status pollable.
Checkpoint resume: ingestion worker pulls last checkpoint → resume, miss → fresh start (your [RESUME] pulling checkpoint-9590 pattern). Kill mid-run once to prove it.
Object storage + large files: scheme PDFs in S3-compatible store; downloads streamed from disk, never buffered in RAM.
Transactional emails: eligibility report email via SMTP/API with queued retry + one failure-path test.
Webhooks: signed inbound re-index webhook (HMAC verify, timestamp skew check) + one forged-signature rejection test.
Real-time: SSE streaming of eligibility answers; reconnect resumes without duplicates.
Concurrency + parallelism: caps on parallel fetches/parses (kaggle's OOM-throttle lesson); document the number and why.
Failure drills: worker crash, webhook forgery, storage miss — each returns the envelope + alert, each covered by a test.
Phase gate: kill -9 the worker mid-ingest → restart resumes from checkpoint, zero duplicate emails sent.
Logging, monitoring, observability: structured JSON logs with request_id + /health + one latency metric. Diagnose one slow request from logs alone.
Graceful shutdown: lifespan handler drains queue + closes pools; in-flight request finishes, new ones get 503 during drain.
Security: headers pass, secrets only via env, auth rotate tested, dependency audit run once.
Scaling + performance: state what breaks first at 1k rps (pool? cache? worker?) + the one fix you'd apply first.
12-factor pass: env-only config, stateless app, logs to stdout, backing services attached as resources — checklist in README.
DevOps: multi-stage Dockerfile + compose (api/postgres/redis/search) + pinned CI running ruff + pytest on push.
Live URL + README: deployed link + arch diagram + EXPLAIN outputs + interview answer for "missing age field without guessing?"
Final gate: fresh clone → docker compose up → full suite green → eligibility + search demoed end-to-end.

if3: Phase 1 skeleton + schemes CRUD + error envelope — the foundation everything plugs into
Phase 2 eligibility BLL with eligible / needs_info / failed + one Redis cache
Phase 3 checkpoint-resume ingestion worker — kill it mid-run and watch it resume
